no_saved_images_yet_upload_a_reference_o: No saved images yet. Upload a reference or take a photo.
reference_examples_provided_by_the_haird: Reference examples provided by the HairDeck authors.
drop_one_head_or_upper_body_reference_he: Drop one head or upper-body reference here.
take_a_photo_with_connected_camera: Take a photo with connected camera
keep_the_whole_hairstyle_in_frame_avoid_: Keep the whole hairstyle in frame. Avoid heavy occlusion and cropped hair. HairDeck reconstructs stylized hair cards; it does not reconstruct the person or produce strand Groom.
recommended_50_steps_cfg_2_chain_generat: Recommended: 50 steps, CFG 2. Chain generation uses HairDeck’s matching 50-step, CFG 2 recipe.
hairdeck_generates_volumetric_hair_cards: HairDeck generates volumetric hair cards and can generate matching spring-bone chains. Use the defaults for the first result.
before_generation_foundry_prepares_all_r: Before generation, Foundry prepares all required weights and selected rig-export tools. Per-card colors add a 734 MB checkpoint on first use. Model licenses are recorded in the package.
compare_every_variation_then_select_the_: Compare every variation, then select the one to fit, style and export. These are HairDeck’s generated hair cards, not a reconstruction of the person.
add_spring_bones_to_this_saved_variation: Add spring bones to this saved variation
review_the_crop_and_segmentation_before_: Review the crop and segmentation before continuing. If the hairstyle is cropped or the wrong region was detected, replace the reference.
reference_colors_preserve_hairdeck_s_pre: Reference colors preserve HairDeck’s prediction. A chosen color replaces it; the saved geometry stays the same.
moves_and_scales_the_generated_hair_and_: Moves and scales the generated hair and its matching chains together. It does not automatically fit a complete character. Review alignment to the selected head.
predicted_per_card_colors_use_unique_uv_: Predicted per-card colors use unique UV areas so each card keeps its own root-to-tip colors. A single-color override can use a shared atlas.
applies_fitting_color_and_material_choic: Applies fitting, color and material choices to the saved hair. No new hair generation is needed.
these_are_the_maps_used_by_this_saved_pr: These are the maps used by this saved preview. Click a map to inspect it at full size or download it for painting.
choose_the_files_to_deliver_the_package_: Choose the files to deliver. The package includes an accurate README, measurements, provenance and resource licenses.
hairdeck_s_head_turn_simulation_this_is_: HairDeck’s head-turn simulation. This is not a 360-degree orbit or an exportable animation clip.
vrm_validation_passed_skinning_and_sprin: VRM validation passed. Skinning and spring groups were checked.
review_the_rig_validation_before_exporti: Review the rig validation before exporting.
spring_bones_are_off_return_to_generatio: Spring bones are off. Return to Generation options to enable VRM or motion.
material_maps_and_uv_layout_accompany_th: Material maps and UV layout accompany the selected geometry. A ZIP and saved History entry are created at completion.
static_glb_is_unrigged_vrm_contains_skin: Static GLB is unrigged. VRM contains skinning and spring data; inspect it with your intended avatar/runtime. Predicted chain counts can differ from the retained bound chains.
one_image_hair_cards_matching_spring_bon: One image. Hair cards. Matching spring bones.
clicking_next_generates_hair_cards_and_m: Clicking Next generates hair cards and matching spring chains.
clicking_next_prepares_the_selected_outp: Clicking Next prepares the selected outputs, package and History entry.
a_reserved_hairdeck_node_id_is_occupied_: A reserved HairDeck node ID is occupied by another node. The graph was preserved.
a_hairdeck_input_has_a_custom_connection: A HairDeck input has a custom connection. The graph was preserved.
the_saved_hairdeck_preview_will_appear_h: The saved HairDeck preview will appear here.
static_review_glb_visible_chain_tubes_ar: Static review GLB. Visible chain tubes are diagnostic geometry, not a bone rig.
drag_to_orbit_scroll_to_zoom_orange_chai: Drag to orbit; scroll to zoom. Orange chains show the prediction. The exported VRM contains the actual skinning and spring physics.
service_hairdeck_card_colors_must_be_fin: HairDeck card colors must be finite RGB samples.
service_name_the_hair_asset_up_to_120_ch: Name the hair asset (up to 120 characters).
service_choose_a_png_jpeg_or_webp_refere: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP reference.
service_select_static_glb_or_rigged_vrm: Select static GLB or rigged VRM.
service_vrm_and_motion_require_spring_bo: VRM and motion require spring bones.
service_supply_x_y_and_z_fitting_offsets: Supply X, Y and Z fitting offsets.
service_use_auto_or_rrggbb_for_hair_colo: Use auto or #RRGGBB for hair color.
service_the_bundled_hairdeck_reference_c: The bundled HairDeck reference changed. Restore the installed example.
service_choose_one_of_the_bundled_hairde: Choose one of the bundled HairDeck examples.
service_the_previous_example_input_chang: The previous example input changed and was preserved.
service_hairdeck_could_not_locate_hair_o: HairDeck could not locate hair or a face. Use a clear, uncropped portrait.
service_the_generated_card_slots_do_not_: The generated card slots do not match color prediction.
service_the_hairdeck_color_model_does_no: The HairDeck color model does not match the selected card model.
service_install_the_pinned_comfyui_haird: Install the pinned ComfyUI-HairDeck node pack and restart ComfyUI.
service_the_selected_reference_head_prof: The selected reference-head profile is not installed.
service_the_hairdeck_color_checkpoint_fa: The HairDeck color checkpoint failed verification.
service_hair_preparation_cancelled_parti: Hair preparation cancelled; partial downloads can resume.
service_the_model_is_downloading_on_firs: The model is downloading on first use. This may take some time but only happens once per model.
service_the_saved_hair_checkpoint_change: The saved hair checkpoint changed; regenerate this variation.
service_the_hairdeck_avatar_failed_valid: The HairDeck avatar failed validation. Keep the generation and revise the head/seed.
service_regenerate_with_spring_bones_bef: Regenerate with spring bones before requesting rigged output.
service_uv: 请选择有效的 UV 模式、贴图尺寸和材质预设。
service_original_author_and_vrm_metadata: Original author and VRM metadata remain in the avatar.
service_choose_a_saved_variation_and_ope: Choose a saved variation and operation.
service_upload_a_reference_smaller_than_: Upload a reference smaller than 20 MB.
service_wait_for_this_hair_job_before_ch: Wait for this hair job before changing options.
service_choose_hair_generation_spring_ch: Choose hair generation, spring chains, material preview, avatar preview, motion preview or export.
service_another_workflow_is_active_wait_: Another workflow is active. Wait before starting hair creation.
service_the_reference_changed_upload_it_: The reference changed. Upload it again before generating.
service_cancelled_completed_hair_variati: Cancelled. Completed hair variations and exports are preserved.
service_hairdeck_did_not_return_a_saved_: HairDeck did not return a saved result.
service_this_file_does_not_belong_to_the: This file does not belong to the saved hair result.
service_request_identity_belongs_to_anot: Request identity belongs to another operation.
service_a_saved_hair_artifact_is_missing: A saved hair artifact is missing.
service_recovered_saved_output_continue_: Recovered saved output. Continue to finish the remaining stages.
service_the_hair_job_was_interrupted_com: The hair job was interrupted. Completed variations remain available.
service_cancelled_completed_hair_generat: Cancelled. Completed hair generations are preserved.
